name: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology
officialName: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology (Deemed to be University)
summary: Sathyabama was founded in 1987 by Dr Jeppiaar as Sathyabama Engineering College and became a deemed university under Section 3 of the UGC Act in 2001. From Jeppiaar Nagar on Rajiv Gandhi Salai it offers about 50 undergraduate programmes across engineering, architecture, science, arts, management, law, pharmacy, nursing and education. It holds NAAC's A++ grade and was ranked 53rd among universities in NIRF 2025. Engineering and architecture admissions are by rank in its own entrance exam, SAEEE.

testing.notes: For engineering, technology and architecture; online, on the Class XII syllabus.
